# CuriousDevs

> CuriousDevs is an AI Engineering Studio for teams that need to build AI capabilities, understand why an existing system fails, and move reliable AI into production.

CuriousDevs is a founding-stage service company based in Noida, India. It works with teams in India and internationally across four service directions:

- **Build**: AI-native products and features, RAG applications, knowledge copilots, AI agents, multi-agent workflows, backend systems, integrations, evaluation baselines, and deployment paths.
- **AI Audit / Assessment**: a measurable review of accuracy, retrieval, grounding, hallucinations, agent behavior, security, cost, latency, and observability, with a failure map and prioritized plan.
- **Fix**: targeted reliability, security, evaluation, cost, latency, retrieval, prompt, integration, and architecture improvements for existing AI systems.
- **Scale**: production infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model routing, caching, observability, cloud or private deployment, runbooks, and engineering handover.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://curiousdevs.com/): positioning, problems, delivery approach, service directions, and founding cohort CTA.
- [Services](https://curiousdevs.com/product): the service catalog and technical capabilities across Build, Audit, Fix, and Scale.
- [Solutions](https://curiousdevs.com/solutions): practical AI use cases across fintech, healthcare, SaaS, retail, logistics, education, manufacturing, and government.
- [FAQ](https://curiousdevs.com/faq): detailed answers about delivery, security, data access, models, timelines, ownership, and engagement terms.
- [How It Works](https://curiousdevs.com/how-it-works): the discover, baseline, engineer, evaluate, secure, deploy, and handover process.
- [Contact](https://curiousdevs.com/contact): direct inquiry form for Build, AI Audit / Assessment, Fix, and Scale.
- [Security](https://curiousdevs.com/security): current security posture and responsible disclosure process.
- [Privacy](https://curiousdevs.com/privacy) and [Terms](https://curiousdevs.com/terms): website policies.

## Important context

- CuriousDevs is currently service-led, not a product company. Product concepts and illustrative diagrams should not be described as generally available software products.
- Public fixed pricing is not being published during the founding customer cohort. Scope and pricing are confirmed after discovery.
- CuriousDevs does not claim SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification. Any framework references describe customer requirements or scenarios, not certifications held by CuriousDevs.
- Contact: hello@curiousdevs.com.
